36 Stat. 2720 (Statutes at Large, govinfo): Proclamation of July 1, 1910, William H. Taft: the Medicine Bow National Forest in Colorado "be known as the Colorado National Forest"

review.note: Wrong action and designation. Proclamation 1062 (July 1, 1910, Taft, 36 Stat. 2720) renamed the Colorado part of the Medicine Bow National Forest as the Colorado National Forest; its diagram is captioned "Name changed from Medicine Bow by this proclamation." It was a national forest, not a "forest reserve."
